- [BNB Greenfield](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/): Decentralized storage and blockchain solution for data ownership, data economy, and EVM programmability.
- [Quick Guide - BNB Greenfield Develop](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/for-developers/get-started-dev/): Quick guide for BNB Greenfield developers covering concepts, account operations, data storage, permission control, cross-chain programmability, SDKs, and developer resources.
- [MindPress Data Marketplace Introduction - BNB Greenfield](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/for-developers/tutorials/app/data-marketplace/): Introduction to the MindPress Data Marketplace demo on BNB Greenfield, showcasing cross-chain programmability, delegate upload, and sponsor-paid storage fees.
- [Storage Provider Lifecycle - BNB Greenfield SP](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/storage-provider/storage-provider-lifecycle/): Describes the full lifecycle of a Greenfield storage provider: preparation, proposal, in-service, maintenance, and exit.
- [opBNB Deployment Configuration Reference](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-opbnb/advanced/opbnb-deployment-configuration/): Reference for opBNB deployment configuration fields and an example deploy config for creating your own opBNB rollup testnet.
- [Creating Your Own L2 Rollup Testnet](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-opbnb/advanced/run-your-own-l2-with-opbnb/): Guide to creating your own opBNB L2 rollup testnet using the opBNB stack, covering architecture, dependencies, and deployment.
- [Quick Guide - opBNB](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-opbnb/developers/quick-guide/): Quick guide for opBNB developers covering network info, wallets, bridges, developer tools, and cross-chain interoperability.
- [Quick Guide - BNB Smart Chain (BSC)](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-smart-chain/developers/quick-guide/): Quick guide for BNB Smart Chain developers covering network info, wallets, JSON-RPC API, and developer tools.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-smart-chain/faq/): Frequently asked questions for BNB Smart Chain, including token recovery, wallet display issues, and hard fork upgrades.
- [BNB Agent Studio Demo](https://docs.bnbchain.org/developer-kit/bnbchain-studio/demo/): Outdated end-to-end demo of BNB Agent Studio building a weather-forecast seller agent on BSC testnet; use the Quickstart instead.
- [BNB Chain Skills](https://docs.bnbchain.org/developer-kit/mcp/skills/): Guide for AI agents to connect to BNB Chain MCP, install BNB Chain skills, and check agent registration.
